channel.title: Abu Dhabi Media Office - Government Affairs
channel.description: Abu Dhabi Media Office - Government Affairs

item.title: Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed chairs Abu Dhabi Executive Council meeting
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council, has chaired an Abu Dhabi Executive Council meeting on the sidelines of the UAE Government Annual Meetings, taking place in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Hazza bin Zayed visits TAMM Factory and reviews Abu Dhabi’s journey towards AI-native government
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hazza bin Zayed Al Nahyan, was briefed on the latest developments, features and evolution of the unified government services platform (TAMM)

item.title: Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed raises UAE flag at Zayed National Museum to mark Flag Day
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council, has raised the UAE flag in front of Zayed National Museum to mark UAE Flag Day, celebrated annually on 3 November.

item.title: Hazza bin Zayed raises UAE flag at Qasr Al Muwaiji to mark Flag Day
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hazza bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler’s Representative in Al Ain Region, has raised the UAE flag at Qasr Al Muwaiji in Al Ain Region to mark Flag Day, observed annually on 3 November.

item.title: Hamdan bin Zayed raises UAE flag at Al Dhafra Fort to mark Flag Day
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler’s Representative in Al Dhafra Region, has raised the UAE flag at Al Dhafra Fort to mark UAE Flag Day, celebrated annually on 3 November as a national occasion to renew loyalty to the nation and reaffirm commitment to preserving its achievements, protecting its values, and advancing its development.

item.title: Mohammed bin Hamdan bin Zayed raises UAE flag at Ruler’s Representative Court in Al Ain Region to mark Flag Day
item.description: His Excellency Sheikh Mohammed bin Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Undersecretary of the Ruler’s Representative Court in Al Ain Region, has raised the UAE flag at the Ruler’s Representative Court in Al Ain Region to mark UAE Flag Day, observed annually on 3 November.

item.title: Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed raises UAE flag at Wahat Al Karama to mark Flag Day
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan has raised the UAE flag at Wahat Al Karama to mark UAE Flag Day

item.title: Abu Dhabi Customs wins GCC Digital Government Award for Invisible Customs initiative
item.description: The General Administration of Abu Dhabi Customs has won the award in the Digitally Distinguished Government Entity category at the 7th GCC Digital Government Award, held in the Kingdom of Bahrain. The award recognises its Invisible Customs initiative and achievements in digital transformation, innovation and the development of smart customs services.

item.title: Hamdan bin Zayed receives Department of Government Enablement delegation and reviews government services and employment opportunities in Al Dhafra Region
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Ruler’s Representative in Al Dhafra Region, received at Al Nakheel Palace in Abu Dhabi a delegation from the Department of Government Enablement (DGE), headed by His Excellency Ahmed Tamim Al Kuttab, Chairman of the Department.

item.title: Organised by Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi, Hospitality Excellence Forum establishes new standards across service sectors
item.description: The Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi (DGE), has organised the Hospitality Excellence Forum, bringing together 280 leaders from more than 80 government, semi-government, free zone and private-sector entities to develop and endorse new hospitality standards for Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed leads UAE delegation at NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, led the United Arab Emirates’ delegation participating in the NDTV World Summit 2026, hosted in the Indian capital, New Delhi.

item.title: Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed meets Prime Minister of India on sidelines of NDTV World Summit 2026
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Chairman of the Presidential Court for Development and Fallen Heroes’ Affairs, has met with His Excellency Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of the Republic of India, on the sidelines of His Highness’ participation in the NDTV World Summit 2026 in New Delhi.

item.title: Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed receives Prime Minister of Singapore at Wahat Al Karama
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, has received Lawrence Wong, Prime Minister of Singapore, at Wahat Al Karama in Abu Dhabi

item.title: UAE President receives French President at start of official visit to UAE
item.description: UAE President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan has received His Excellency Emmanuel Macron, President of the French Republic, who arrived in the UAE today on an official visit.

item.title: UAE President and French President discuss cooperation and regional developments
item.description: UAE President His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan and His Excellency Emmanuel Macron, President of the French Republic, have discussed ways to enhance strategic ties between the UAE and France

item.title: Under the directives of Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed, Department of Government Enablement announces establishment of TAMM Global company to expand TAMM platform’s global reach
item.description: Under the directives of His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council, the Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi (DGE) has announced the establishment of Abu Dhabi Digital Services Company TAMM Global.

item.title: UAE President directs renaming Al Ain International Airport to Tahnoun International Airport
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the UAE, has directed the renaming of Al Ain International Airport to Tahnoun International Airport

item.title: Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi launches AiNative training programme in collaboration with OpenAI, Microsoft and MBZUAI
item.description: The Department of Government Enablement – Abu Dhabi has launched AiNative, an AI training programme built with OpenAI, Microsoft and MBZUAI for every government employee

item.title: In the presence of Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed, Tahnoon bin Zayed chairs meeting of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Technology Council
item.description: In the presence of His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council and Vice Chairman of the Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Technology Council (AIATC), His Highness Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of the AIATC, has chaired a meeting of the council.

item.title: Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed issues resolution appointing Dr. Mohamed Abdalla Al Zaabi as Undersecretary of Department of Culture and Tourism
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of Abu Dhabi Executive Council, has issued a resolution appointing His Excellency Dr. Mohamed Abdalla Al Zaabi as Undersecretary of the Department of Culture and Tourism – Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Abu Dhabi Housing Authority wins 1st place at GCC Housing Award for West Bani Yas Residential Project
item.description: The West Bani Yas Residential Project, developed by the Abu Dhabi Housing Authority (ADHA), has won first place in the seventh GCC Housing Award, held under the theme ‘An Integrated Housing Project with Comprehensive Services that Enhances Quality of Life’.

item.title: Sultan of Oman receives Tahnoon bin Zayed
item.description: His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tariq Al Said, Sultan and Prime Minister of Oman, has received His Highness Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Deputy Ruler of Abu Dhabi and National Security Adviser, along with his accompanying delegation, at Al Baraka Palace, as part of an official visit by His Highness to the Sultanate of Oman.

item.title: Hazza bin Zayed receives Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed at his residence in Al Ain Region
item.description: His Highness Sheikh Hazza bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Ruler’s Representative in Al Ain Region, has received at his residence in Al Ain Region His Highness Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi and Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council.

item.title: Executive Council issues resolution appointing Abdulla Hamad Alghfeli as Director General of Integrated Transport Centre
item.description: Abu Dhabi Executive Council has issued a resolution appointing His Excellency Abdulla Hamad Alghfeli as Director General of the Integrated Transport Centre.
